study: M8 referee history vs Crown AH
scope: Research only; original M8 eight groups and production untouched.
rejected_attempts: Initial feature run omitted chronological sorting before as-of referee lookback; independent verifier detected mismatched lookback features. Those preliminary results were discarded. Final run sorted by kickoff date/FID, reran all model/quote inputs, and the independent as-of-feature verifier passed.
An earlier card-feature draft was removed because player appearance data has missing match rows; no missing appearance/card rows are interpreted as zero or used as referee features.

crown_raw_responses.source_time_class: historical Crown source-event rows; not verified pregame HTTP receipts

model_specification.target: home AH unit return minus away AH unit return under same Crown T12 line and prices
model_specification.features: Crown market line and normalized home implied probability; prior same-competition referee-vs-Crown margin residual and history count, 730-day lookback; target date and previous two calendar dates excluded. Incomplete player-appearance/card records were audited and excluded from model features
model_specification.train: expanding all prior years, separate calendar-year folds 2024/2025/2026; fixed ridge alpha=100; no target-year labels or future M8 membership in features

independent_verification.study: Independent verifier for referee-history M8 Crown AH research
